name: Volxkino
notes: Wix site with no server-rendered schedule markup; all event data is embedded as JSON in the <script id="wix-warmup-data"> tag (Wix Events widget's SSR warmup payload) - parsed as JSON, not scraped from HTML text. 15 screenings currently published, running through 31 Aug 2026 (rest of the summer open-air season); price never stated anywhere (RSVP-only Wix ticketing, no price field) so price_min/price_text always null; category always null (site assigns no per-event category); district taken from the free-text address (occasionally disagrees with the structured postalCode field by a district or two - address text wins as it's what's shown to users).
